releases.name: v0.3.0 — auto-detect retry-after hints
releases.body:
## Auto-detect retry windows

The plugin now parses explicit "retry after" / "please try again in X" hints from rate-limit responses and schedules the next attempt for exactly that time plus a small buffer (default +1s), instead of blind exponential backoff.

### Hint sources (priority order)
1. `Retry-After` header (when `honorRetryAfter` is set)
2. Reset headers — `x-ratelimit-reset-after`, `anthropic-ratelimit-tokens-reset`, `ratelimit-reset`, etc. (epoch s/ms, relative counts, ISO dates)
3. Response body text — "try again in 1.5s", "retry after 30s", "reset in 6m0s", "wait 10 seconds", "available in 45s"
4. Transport error message text (same patterns)

The duration parser handles compound forms (`6m0s`, `2m30s`, `1h2m3s`), decimals (`1.5s`), explicit units, and bare seconds.

### New config (all optional, overridable from opencode.json)
- `retryHints` — master switch, default `true`
- `retryHintBufferMs` — added on top of each hint, default `1000`
- `retryHintMaxMs` — cap on a hint-derived delay, default `300000`
- `retryHintHeaders` — header names to inspect
- `retryHintPatterns` — body/error regex patterns (first capture group = duration)

Verified with a clean typecheck/build and 21 parser unit checks.

releases.name: v0.2.0 — TUI retry notifications
releases.body:
## Highlights

Surface retry activity via opencode TUI toasts so the agent no longer looks frozen during a long outage. Each toast carries the host, short reason, and a truncated body / error excerpt so failure detail is preserved (not just the status code).

## What's new

- New `notify` option (`"off" | "events" | "verbose"`, default `"events"`).
- New `notifyMinDelayMs`, `notifyThrottleMs`, `notifyDurationMs` knobs for tuning toast frequency / duration.
- Warning toast on **every** retry (default), success toast on recovery, error toast when giving up in non-sticky mode.
- Toast text includes the response body excerpt or full error chain, whitespace-collapsed and truncated for readability — never omitted.
- Graceful degradation when `client.tui.showToast` is unavailable on older opencode builds.

## Usage

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": [["opencode-sticky-retry", {
    "notify": "events"
  }]]
}
```

Set `notify: "off"` to silence, or `notify: "verbose"` to surface every retry regardless of how short the backoff is.

See [README · Notifications](https://github.com/ronanhansel/opencode-sticky-retry#notifications) for details.

**Full diff:** https://github.com/ronanhansel/opencode-sticky-retry/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0
